findings.title: Comparator quantities described as unextracted despite recorded adoption
findings.page_quote: <dt>k</dt><dd>NOT EXTRACTED from held text</dd><dt>effect</dt><dd>NOT EXTRACTED from held text</dd><dt>ci</dt><dd>NOT EXTRACTED from held text</dd>

evidence.quote: For primary prevention in the elderly, seven trials (21,781 patients in total), 29 , 35 – 40 identified a similar risk of cardiovascular events between patients on statins and the control group (OR: 0.88, 95% CI: 0.72–1.06; GRADE: moderate).

findings.why: The panel's null fields are presented as evidence that extraction never occurred. However, comparator.reported contains the adopted estimate, confidence interval, and source span identifying seven trials.
findings.fix: Render the recorded adopted quantities, or explicitly say that these panel fields are unpopulated while the adopted result is recorded elsewhere in the review object.

findings.title: Refused-pool inputs described as pooled numbers
findings.page_quote: Every pooled number on this page, with the passage it was read from

evidence.quote: "detail": "k=2 pooled row refused because point estimates are on opposite sides of the null"

findings.why: The table shows PLATO and PHILO individual effects, but its introduction calls them pooled numbers despite the primary synthesis being refused.
findings.fix: Describe these as recorded trial-level inputs and state that the synthesis is refused.
